app.name: WASAC: fagitire y'amazi
error.offline: Nta murandasi uhari. Reba interineti ya telefoni yawe cyangwa Wi-Fi, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
error.timeout: Biratinze cyane. Reba interineti ya telefoni yawe, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
error.server: Sisitemu yacu ntiyabashije kubikora ubu. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota mike.
error.notFound: Ntitwabonye konti yawe. Hamagara serivisi y'abakiriya ba WASAC.
error.invalid: Hari ikitemewe muri ibi wohereje. Bigenzure maze wongere ugerageze.
language.label: Ururimi
nav.label: Ibyingenzi
camera.title: Soma mubazi yawe
camera.unavailable.title: Kamera ntiboneka
camera.unavailable.body: Emerera mushakisha (browser) gukoresha kamera mu igenamiterere ryayo, cyangwa wohereze ifoto ya mubazi yawe.
camera.photoKept: Ifoto yawe yabitswe, ntukeneye kongera kuyifata.
camera.saved: Ufite ifoto itaroherezwa. Yohereze, cyangwa ufate indi.
camera.notImage: Iyo dosiye si ifoto. Hitamo ifoto ya mubazi yawe.
camera.unreadable.title: Ntitwashoboye gusoma imibare iri kuri iyi foto
camera.unreadable.body: Sukura ikirahure cya mubazi, urebe ko hari urumuri, maze ufotore wegereye imibare.
camera.liveOff: Inama zihita zigaragara zahagaritswe kugira ngo uzigame interineti.
camera.liveEnded: Inama zihita zigaragara zahagaze. Fata ifoto igihe imibare iri mu kazu.
camera.cropAlt: Imibare ya mubazi, yakuwe ku ifoto yawe
guidance.noMeter: Ntitwabonye mubazi y'amazi. Erekeza kamera ku kazu k'imibare ka mubazi.
guidance.cutOff: Imibare imwe ishobora kuba itagaragara yose. Gerageza gusubira inyuma gato.
guidance.tooDark: Harasa n'ahijimye. Gerageza gucana itara cyangwa ukoreshe itara rya telefoni yawe.
guidance.glare: Hashobora kuba hari urumuri rwigaragaza ku kirahure. Gerageza guhengamira telefoni gato.
guidance.hardToRead: Imibare ntigaragara neza. Niba ikirahure cyanduye cyangwa gitose, gihanagure buhoro maze wongere ugerageze.
guidance.checkNumbers: Reba neza niba imibare ari yo.
guidance.aim: Erekeza kamera ku mibare ya mubazi, ntunyeganyege.
confirm.title: Genzura imibare
confirm.question: Iyi mibare irahura n'iri kuri mubazi yawe?
confirm.tapHint: Kanda ku mubare kugira ngo uwuhindure.
confirm.manual: Andika imibare 8 yose iri kuri mubazi yawe: 5 iri ku birabura, hanyuma 3 iri ku mutuku.
confirm.needsCheck: Twasomye {raw}. Genzura imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe maze uyandike hano.
confirm.needsCheckEmpty: Genzura imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe maze uyandike hano.
confirm.incomplete: Uzuza imibare 8 yose. Niba hari aho nta mubare ugaragara, andika 0.
confirm.retakeBody: Ntitwashoboye gukoresha iki gipimo. Ongera ufotore wegereye imibare kandi hari urumuri ruhagije.
held.title: Igipimo cyoherejwe
held.checkingBody: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura iki gipimo. Narangiza, igisubizo kizagaragara mu Butumwa. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.
bill.title: Fagitire ya {month}
bill.howNote: Uko ukoresha amazi menshi mu kwezi, ni ko igiciro cya buri metero kibe y'inyongera kizamuka. Amafaranga ya serivisi ni amwe buri kwezi.
pay.title: Ishyura ukoresheje Mobile Money
pay.from: Uzishyura ukoresheje nimero ya MTN Mobile Money iri kuri konti yawe: {phone}.
pay.unsure: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza ubwishyu. Banza urebe fagitire zawe mbere yo kongera kugerageza, kugira ngo utishyura kabiri.
history.title: Fagitire zawe
history.empty: Nta fagitire uragira. Fata ifoto ya mbere ya mubazi yawe.
history.checking: Fagitire yawe ya mbere izagaragara hano umukozi wa WASAC namara kugenzura igipimo cyawe.
home.readPrompt: Soma mubazi yawe kugira ngo ubone fagitire ikurikira.
home.checkingBody: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura igipimo wohereje. Igisubizo kizagaragara mu Butumwa. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.
home.highUse: Twabonye ko wakoresheje amazi menshi kurusha uko bisanzwe. Soma ubutumwa urebe ibyo ukwiye kugenzura.
messages.title: Ubutumwa
messages.empty: Nta butumwa. Tuzakubwira hano nitubona ikintu kidasanzwe ku mikoreshereze yawe y'amazi.
msg.SPIKE.title: Amazi menshi cyane kurusha uko bisanzwe
msg.SPIKE.noticed: Ku wa {date}, mubazi yawe yerekanye amazi menshi cyane kurusha ayo urugo rwawe rusanzwe rukoresha.
msg.SUSTAINED_HIGH.title: Amazi menshi kuva igihe runaka
msg.SUSTAINED_HIGH.noticed: Imikoreshereze yawe y'amazi imaze ibipimo byinshi iri hejuru y'uko bisanzwe, kugeza ku wa {date}.
msg.MISREAD_SUSPECTED.title: Igipimo kiri munsi y'icyaheruka
msg.MISREAD_SUSPECTED.noticed: Igipimo wohereje ku wa {date} kiri munsi y'icyaheruka. Mubazi zibara zizamuka gusa, ni yo mpamvu tugenzura ibipimo nk'ibi.
msg.METER_STUCK.title: Mubazi yawe ishobora kuba itagenda
msg.METER_STUCK.noticed: Mubazi yawe imaze igihe yerekana igipimo kimwe, kugeza ku wa {date}. Niba ukoresha amazi kandi imibare ntihinduke, hamagara serivisi y'abakiriya ba WASAC.
msg.UNUSUAL.title: Igipimo kidasanzwe
msg.UNUSUAL.noticed: Igipimo wohereje ku wa {date} gitandukanye n'uko usanzwe ukoresha amazi.
msg.leak.checkTitle: Reba niba hari aho amazi ava:
msg.leak.check3: ubutaka cyangwa inkuta bitose hafi y'amatiyo yawe
msg.leak.cost: Amazi ava anyura muri mubazi yawe kandi abarwa kuri fagitire yawe, bityo kanika aho amazi ava vuba uko ubishoboye.
msg.status.open: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura iki gipimo. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.
msg.status.accepted: Cyagenzuwe kandi cyemejwe. Fagitire yawe yabonetse.
msg.status.rejected: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza iki gipimo. Ongera usome mubazi yawe.
landing.title: Soma mubazi yawe y'amazi mu munota umwe.
landing.lede: Fotora mubazi yawe, genzura imibare, maze wishyure fagitire yawe ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money.
landing.step1: Fotora imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe.
landing.step2: Genzura imibare twasomye maze ukosore iyo twibeshyeho.
landing.step3: Reba fagitire yawe maze uyishyure ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money.
error.unauthorized: Igihe cyawe cyo kwinjira cyarangiye. Ongera winjire.
error.locked: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi zitari zo. Tegereza iminota 5, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
error.conflict: Undi muntu yamaze kubikemura. Ongera ufungure urupapuro urebe ibigezweho.
error.tooMany: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi mu gihe gito. Tegereza umunota umwe, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
error.tooLarge: Iyi foto ni nini cyane. Fata indi foto, cyangwa uhitemo nto.
demo.label: Amakuru y'igerageza
signin.title: Kwinjira kw'abakozi
signin.lede: Ni iy'abakozi ba WASAC bashinzwe fagitire n'abo mu murima. Genzura ibipimo byahagaritswe kandi ukurikirane ingo.
signin.wrong: Izina n'ijambo ry'ibanga ntibihura. Bigenzure maze wongere ugerageze.
signin.help: Wibagiwe ijambo ry'ibanga? Saba umuyobozi wawe kurihindura.
staff.stat.openFlagsNote: Harimo aho amazi ashobora kuba ava
staff.households.search: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, mubazi cyangwa umurenge
staff.review.lede: Ibipimo {count} bitegereje. Gereranya buri kimwe n'imikoreshereze isanzwe y'urugo.
staff.review.keys: Utubuto: J ikurikira, K ibanziriza, A emeza, R anga, U subiza inyuma.
staff.review.noPhoto: Ifoto ya mubazi ntabwo iracyabikwanwa n'ibipimo.
staff.review.acceptNote: Kwemeza bikora fagitire. Kwanga bisaba urugo, binyuze mu Butumwa, kohereza indi foto.
staff.review.rejected: Igipimo cya {name} cyanzwe. Bazasabwa kohereza indi foto.
staff.review.empty: Nta bipimo bitegereje icyemezo. Ibipimo bishya byahagaritswe bizagaragara hano.
notFound.title: Uru rupapuro ntirubaho
notFound.body: Genzura aderesi, cyangwa usubire aho watangiriye.
